class.name: TimeOfDayProfile
class.brief_description: A day for [TimeOfDay]: properties of the lights, the environment and other nodes, as curves and gradients over 24 hours.
class.description: A [TimeOfDayProfile] holds tracks. Each track ties one property of one target to a [Curve], for numbers and booleans, or a [Gradient], for colors, that spans the day. The curve's X axis covers the whole day whatever its domain, so a curve from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]24.0[/code] reads in hours. The gradient's offsets run from midnight ([code]0.0[/code]) to the next midnight ([code]1.0[/code]). Integers are rounded, and booleans are [code]true[/code] from [code]0.5[/code] up. In the Inspector, the property of a track can be picked from the properties of the actual target; picking one gives the track a flat curve or gradient at its current value to start from. A property can reach into a sub-resource with a colon, such as [code]material_override:albedo_color[/code]. If several tracks drive the same property, the last one wins. The same class describes weather, as [member TimeOfDay.weather]: it only needs the tracks it changes.

method.name: add_track
method.description: Adds a track driving [param property] of [param target], and returns its index. [param node_path] is only used by [constant TARGET_NODE], relative to the [TimeOfDay] node. Give it a curve with [method set_track_curve] or a gradient with [method set_track_gradient].

method.name: create_default
method.description: Returns a new profile with a whole day, made for a [ProceduralSkyMaterial] sky: the sun's energy and color, a moonlit night, the sky and ground colors through dawn and dusk, and a fog that thickens in the morning. Its keys assume sunrise at 6:00 and sunset at 18:00.

method.name: find_track
method.description: Returns the index of the last track driving [param property] of [param target] (and of [param node_path] for [constant TARGET_NODE]), or [code]-1[/code].

method.name: get_track_curve
method.description: Returns the [Curve] of the track at [param index].

method.name: get_track_gradient
method.description: Returns the [Gradient] of the track at [param index].

method.name: get_track_node_path
method.description: Returns the node path of the track at [param index].

method.name: get_track_property
method.description: Returns the property the track at [param index] drives.

method.name: get_track_target
method.description: Returns the target of the track at [param index].

method.name: set_track_curve
method.description: Sets the [Curve] the track at [param index] follows for a number or a boolean.

method.name: set_track_gradient
method.description: Sets the [Gradient] the track at [param index] follows for a color.

method.name: set_track_node_path
method.description: Sets the node a [constant TARGET_NODE] track drives, relative to the [TimeOfDay] node. Subnames reach into its resources, as in [code]../Clouds:material_override[/code].

method.name: set_track_property
method.description: Sets the property the track at [param index] drives.

method.name: set_track_target
method.description: Sets the target of the track at [param index].

constants.constant: The material of the [Environment]'s [Sky], such as a [ProceduralSkyMaterial].
Any node, or a resource of one, found at the track's node path.
